jeddah.event.title: The event: Jeddah flood
jeddah.event.src: Figures reported by GDACS, quoting the National Center of Meteorology.
jeddah.event.imerg: NASA GPM IMERG rain data comes first: Early run about 4 hours after the rain, Late about 12 to 14 hours, Final about 3.5 months. A satellite picture only shows what happened afterwards.
jeddah.event.background: Jeddah also flooded in 2009 and 2011; those years are outside the 2015 to 2026 timeline of this game.
jeddah.trade.optical: light, low power, sharp, little data. It sees only when there is no cloud; storm cloud blinds it.
jeddah.trade.radar: sees through cloud and at night, but heavy, power hungry, costly and makes a lot of data.
jeddah.alive.yes: Yes: in orbit on the day of the storm.
jeddah.alive.reentered: No: it reentered on {date}, before the storm.
jeddah.alive.not_launched: No: it was not yet in orbit on the day of the storm.
jeddah.alive.note: The Sun still decides how long the satellite lives: a lower orbit gives sharper pictures but may fall before the storm.

slot.camera.does: The camera sets how sharp your pictures are and how much ground you cover.
slot.panels.does: Panels turn sunlight into power. Too small and the battery runs dry in eclipse.
slot.battery.does: The battery carries the satellite through the dark part of each orbit.
slot.radio.does: The radio decides how much data you can send down in each pass over Funda.
slot.computer.does: The computer stores and handles your images before they are sent.
slot.pointing.does: Pointing aims the camera. Better aiming widens the strip you can reach.
slot.fuel.does: Fuel lets you lift the orbit back up. Each push adds days of life.
slot.camera.why: A sharper camera makes more data every day and sees a narrower strip, so it leans on the radio, storage and power you pair it with.
slot.panels.why: Panels set the power margin: what they make, averaged over the sunlit part of each orbit, has to cover everything the satellite draws.
slot.battery.why: The battery has to carry the whole eclipse. If its usable energy is less than the satellite draws in the dark, the energy check fails.
slot.radio.why: The radio sets how many MB per day can come down. Whatever the camera makes beyond that waits in storage or is lost.
slot.computer.why: Storage holds images until a pass. When it is full, new images are lost.
slot.pointing.why: Pointing multiplies the strip the camera can reach, which cuts the wait between looks at the same place.
slot.fuel.why: When the orbit has dropped 10 km, the thruster pushes it back up until the delta-v runs out. Each push buys days before reentry.
